```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Load time-weight data
#tW_apo <- read.csv("/Users/carolineianniello/DEB/Astrangia_poculata_apo/tW_predictions_6_20.csv")
#tW_sym <- read.csv("/Users/carolineianniello/DEB/Astrangia_poculata_sym/tW_predictions_6_20..csv")

# Load temperature-respiration data
TJO_apo <- read.csv("/Users/carolineianniello/DEB/Astrangia_Add_My_Pet/Results/TJO_predictions_APO.csv")
TJO_sym <- read.csv("/Users/carolineianniello/DEB/Astrangia_Add_My_Pet/Results/TJO_predictions_SYM.csv")
#TJO_up_to_55 <- read.csv("/Users/carolineianniello/DEB/Astrangia_Add_My_Pet/Results/TJO_predictions_to_55C_APO_and_SYM.csv")
TJO_apo$resp_pred <- Re(TJO_apo$resp_pred)  #MATLAB included some non-real numbers so just turning them into real numbers
TJO_sym$resp_pred <- Re(TJO_sym$resp_pred)  #MATLAB included some non-real numbers so just turning them into real numbers
#TJO_up_to_55$resp_pred_umolO2_gd <- Re(TJO_up_to_55$resp_pred_umolO2_gd) 

#tW_apo$weight_pred <- Re(tW_apo$weight_pred)
#tW_sym$weight_pred <- Re(tW_sym$weight_pred)
```



```{r TJO Graphs - separate}
#APO
ggplot(TJO_apo, aes(x = temperature)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = resp_obs), color = "black", size = 2, shape = 16) +  # observed
  geom_smooth(aes(y = resp_pred), method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, color = "blue", size = 1) +  # smoothed predicted
  labs(title = "Temperature vs. O2 Consumption",
       x = "Temperature (°C)",
       y = "O2 Consumption (µmol/g/d)") +
  theme_minimal()

#SYM
ggplot(TJO_sym, aes(x = temperature)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = resp_obs), color = "black", size = 2, shape = 16) +  # observed
  geom_smooth(aes(y = resp_pred), method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, color = "blue", size = 1) +  # smoothed predicted
  labs(title = "Temperature vs. O2 Consumption",
       x = "Temperature (°C)",
       y = "O2 Consumption (µmol/g/d)") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r TJO Graphs - combined with jitter}

#COMBINED GRAPH
# Add symbiotic state to each dataset
TJO_apo$sym_state <- "Aposymbiotic"
TJO_sym$sym_state <- "Symbiotic"

# Combine datasets
TJO_combined <- rbind(TJO_apo, TJO_sym)
ggplot(TJO_combined, aes(x = temperature)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = resp_obs, color = sym_state), 
             size = 3, 
             shape = 16,  
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.3),  
             alpha = 0.6) +  
  geom_smooth(aes(y = resp_pred, color = sym_state), 
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, size = 1.25) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Aposymbiotic" = "#636363", "Symbiotic" = "#964B00")) +
  labs(title = "Temperature vs. O2 Consumption",
       x = "Temperature (°C)",
       y = expression("O"[2]~"Consumption (µmol/g/d)"), 
       color = "Symbiotic State") +
 # ylim(0,35000) +
#  xlim(5,32) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22),  
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22),  
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),   
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    # Increase legend title and text size (double original?)
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),  # default is ~11, so size 22 here
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),    # default ~9, size 18 here
    # Increase legend keys (symbols) size
    legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "lines")  # default ~1 line, 1.5 or 2 lines to double symbol size
  )

ggsave("high_res_TJO_plot.png", type = "cairo", dpi = 300)
```

```{r TJO - Combined no jitter}
TJO_apo$sym_state <- "Aposymbiotic"
TJO_sym$sym_state <- "Symbiotic"
TJO_combined <- rbind(TJO_apo,TJO_sym)
# Plot with jittered points and different shapes for Apo and Sym
ggplot(TJO_combined, aes(x = temperature)) +
  # Jittered points with larger dodge and transparent dots
  
  # Smoothed predicted values
  geom_smooth(aes(y = resp_pred, color = sym_state), 
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, size = 1.25) +  # smoothed predicted +
  ylim(0,45000) +
    xlim(5,32)+
  
  # Define custom colors for sym_state
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Aposymbiotic" = "#636363", "Symbiotic" = "#964B00")) +
  
  # Add titles and axis labels
  labs(title = "Temperature vs. O2 Consumption",
       x = "Temperature (°C)",
       y = expression("O"[2]~"Consumption (µmol/g/d)"), 
       color = "Symbiotic State") +
  
  # Apply minimal theme and increase axis label sizes and ticks
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),  # Increase size of x-axis label
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),  # Increase size of y-axis label
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),   # Increase size of x-axis ticks
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13)    # Increase size of y-axis ticks
  ) 
```


#ARCHIVES
```{r TJO up to 55 combined with Jitter}

ggplot() +
   geom_point(
     data = TJO_combined,
     aes(x = temperature, y = resp_obs, color = sym_state),
     position = position_jitter(width = 0.3),
     alpha = 0.5, size = 2
   ) +
# Plot predicted lines
  geom_line(
    data = TJO_up_to_55,
    aes(
      x = temperature_C,
      y = resp_pred_umolO2_gd,
      color = symbiotic_state,
      group = symbiotic_state
    ),
    size = 1.5
  ) +

  # Color scheme (tweak if you like)  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Aposymbiotic" = "#636363", "Symbiotic" = "#964B00"),
    labels = c("Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic")
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Temperature vs. Predicted O"[2]~ "Consumption up to 55°C",
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = expression("O"[2]~"Consumption (µmol/g/d)"),
    color = "Symbiotic State"
  ) +
  xlim(6, 55) +
  ylim(0, NA) +  # Remove NA if you want to set max Y explicitly
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "lines")
  )

# Save the plot as high-res PNG
ggsave("predicted_respiration_up_to_55C.png", dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 7)
```
